task_instance: Ingest a single YouTube video's transcript into a markdown vault using the skill's bundled ingest.py (python3 ingest.py <video-url> --vault .), producing the External Inputs/YouTube/<channel-slug>/<date>-<video-slug>.md note with metadata frontmatter and cleaned transcript prose, plus any capture-seed stubs.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable is fetching a real YouTube video's subtitles/metadata and normalizing them into a vault note. The bundled ingest.py requires the external program yt-dlp (it calls require_bin('yt-dlp') and exits non-zero with install instructions if absent, then shells out to it for --list-subs, subtitle download and metadata). yt-dlp is not installed on this machine (not on PATH, no yt_dlp python module), and it cannot be installed because the runtime is air-gapped with no package registry or network. Even if yt-dlp were present, the actual transcript/metadata retrieval requires reaching the YouTube/CDN service over the network, which this offline runtime does not provide. Per the run rules, yt-dlp is a required external program named by the skill; I did not write a replacement/stub, nor fabricate subtitle or metadata output. Sample input here would be a YouTube URL, but the skill cannot turn it into a real transcript offline.
evidence: Read SKILL.md (steps 2-7 and Dependencies require yt-dlp, which fetches subtitles and metadata over the network). Listed the skill folder: SKILL.md and ingest.py are both present (ingest.py copied into the work dir). Checked 'command -v yt-dlp' -> 'NO yt-dlp'; 'python3 -c import yt_dlp' -> ImportError. grep of ingest.py shows require_bin('yt-dlp') at line 299 and the 'not installed... install with brew/pip3' error at lines 108-112, confirming the script hard-exits without the tool. Installing is impossible (no network, installs forbidden) and reaching the YouTube service is impossible on an air-gapped workstation. Attempts to run 'python3 ingest.py <url>' were additionally blocked by the environment's external-code classifier, but the determinative blocker is the missing yt-dlp tool plus absent network. No vault note could be produced or verified.
